jobs.title: Principal Architect (1C9D035)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a financial technology business that provides banks with the data intelligence behind personalised digital banking. Its platform runs in demanding client environments, with much of the estate currently deployed on-premises and an active migration towards cloud.

As Principal Architect, you'll own the architecture of the whole platform: services, data, integrations, deployment models and the boundaries between them. Reporting directly to the CTO, you'll set technical direction, make difficult trade-offs and remain accountable for whether the architecture supports the business as it scales.

The business is undertaking a funded platform transformation spanning performance, architecture and AI. This is not a review-and-advise position or a programme management role. You'll draft the target architecture, defend it with engineers and customers, and stay close to implementation so you can correct drift early. The work is about shaping the technical outcome while ensuring today's delivery remains consistent with the platform's longer-term direction.

The Role

Define and own the target architecture, establishing the platform structure and clear service boundaries that engineers can use to make implementation decisions.
Shape the technical transformation from on-premises to cloud, from MSSQL to PostgreSQL and from legacy systems to a coherent platform. Stay close enough to delivery to identify divergence before it becomes entrenched.
Document architectural decisions through RFCs, architecture decision records and technical strategy. Write clearly enough that teams can understand the rationale, resolve debates and act on the agreed direction.
Embed AI as a first-class architectural concern across services, data pipelines and the software development lifecycle, rather than treating it only as an additional feature.
Explain and defend the architecture with both internal engineers and bank-side architects, balancing technical credibility with clear communication about trade-offs.
Make decisions that work across on-premises client installations and cloud environments, maintaining practical awareness of both during the migration.

What We're Looking For

Ownership of a distributed, data-heavy platform architecture in production, with significant customer expectations. Designing a system in isolation is not enough; you should be able to explain how your decisions held up in operation.
Experience moving a live system from one architecture to another without stopping the business, with an honest account of the costs, compromises and lessons.
Deep C# and .NET knowledge, strong MSSQL and PostgreSQL experience, and practical exposure to both on-premises and cloud systems. You'll need to read implementation code critically, not operate solely at diagram level.
Hands-on understanding of Azure, Kafka, Kubernetes, Helm charts and distributed systems at scale.
Clear technical writing, demonstrated through RFCs, decision records or public technical communication. You should be able to turn an architectural judgement into an explicit, usable decision.
Credibility with engineers and customers, including bank architects who will challenge the proposed direction.
An active approach to reasoning about how AI changes architecture and engineering practice, including use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.

Relevant Desirable Experience

RabbitMQ, Terraform, GCP or Python.
Fintech or another regulated industry where technical decisions must work within demanding client constraints.

Working Environment

This is a B2B contract engagement with two office days and three remote days each week. The source lists equity participation through an employee share option programme, private healthcare and support for wellbeing and everyday working costs. The role combines a direct reporting line to the CTO with authority to set technical direction and accountability for the resulting architecture.

Interview Process

A 30-minute screening call covers transformations you've led and what you learned. A 60-minute CTO discussion explores architecture, trade-offs and change at scale. A 90-minute architecture deep-dive uses a real platform problem, with AI tools welcome. The employer states that a decision or offer follows within ten days of the final interview.

This could suit a principal or platform architect who has already led a live technical transformation and wants whole-platform ownership while remaining close to code, engineering decisions and customer requirements.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Position:
Software Engineer
Location:
Solna, Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid)

Move Security Forward with Acre

Are you passionate about transforming the future of security? Do you thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment where your contributions drive real impact? If so, Acre Security is the place for you. Join us in making the world a safer place, one innovation at a time.

About Acre

At Acre, we're not just building security solutions, we're empowering security professionals to adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. Since our inception in 2012, Acre has been at the forefront of innovation in access control, visitor management, and intrusion software. Our solutions are trusted by organisations in over 25 countries, delivering smarter, more adaptable, and easier-to-use security technologies that protect what matters most.

Your Impact

We're looking for an experienced Software Engineer
to join our Research & Development
team in Solna, Stockholm. The team builds and develops access control software solutions under the Omnis
brand.
In this role, you will:
Develop access control software solutions
– Contribute to the design, implementation, testing and maintenance of software throughout the development lifecycle.
Build software integrations
– Develop and maintain integrations with electronic hardware components including access control controllers, intrusion panels, wireless locks, DVRs, cameras and other security equipment.
Work as a full-stack developer
– Collaborate in an Agile development environment while delivering innovative security solutions.

What You'll Do

In addition to the above, your key responsibilities will include:
Design and develop the Omnis platform
– Lead or participate in the design, architecture and implementation of the Omnis access control system.
Develop software across the full lifecycle
– Design, implement, test and maintain software solutions from concept through deployment and support.
Create hardware and system integrations
– Work with a range of connected security devices and software integrations, primarily developed in C#.
Collaborate with stakeholders
– Participate in design reviews, code reviews and demonstrations with peers and stakeholders.
Support Agile development practices
– Contribute to an Agile development environment while maintaining high-quality software standards.

What You'll Bring

To succeed in this role, you'll need:
Relevant education and experience
– Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with at least 5 years of post-graduate experience in embedded software development.
Strong programming expertise
– Proficiency programming in C/C++ and C#.
Technical systems knowledge
– Familiarity with computer system architecture and application processor (SoC) fundamentals including caches, buses, memory controllers and DMA.
Database and networking experience
– Experience working with relational databases, preferably SQLBase, together with TCP/IP and networking knowledge.
Strong software engineering skills
– Experience with source control, defect tracking, design documentation, customer documentation, software debugging and Agile development processes.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Familiarity with access control, intrusion detection or video management systems.
Experience leveraging AI for design and development work.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Effective communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills.
A strong team-player mindset.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Swedish.

What's in It for You

We strive to do more than just match your ambitions. When you join Acre, you'll have access to a range of exciting opportunities:
Be part of a disruptor
– Help move security forward with a company that challenges the status quo and redefines industry standards.
Learn from industry leaders
– Work alongside experts and innovators driving real change in security technology.
Drive meaningful impact
– Your work will directly contribute to pioneering security technologies that protect businesses and communities worldwide.
Advance your career
– Access professional development opportunities, including training programmes, mentorship and industry events.
Enjoy competitive rewards
– We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives and a comprehensive benefits programme that reflects your contributions.

Join the Future of Security

Acre offers the chance to be part of a fast-growing international business where you have the potential to grow, influence and make an impact. If you're ready to make a difference in a fast-moving, innovative industry, we'd love to hear from you.

Acre is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Unityprogrammerare (C#) till Terrahutton, Göteborg
jobs.description:
Terrahutton grundades 2024 och räknas idag som världsledande inom visualisering av gruvprojekt. Vår plattform låter gruv- och prospekteringsbolag presentera geologi, borrresultat och projektpotential i en interaktiv 3D-miljö, i stället för genom skärmdumpar och statiska slides. Den används av bolag världen över när de presenterar sina projekt för investerare och andra intressenter, från juniora prospekteringsbolag till världens största gruvbolag, BHP. Plattformen bygger vi själva i Unity, från vårt kontor i Göteborg.

Vi fortsätter att växa i snabb takt, och nu söker vi en Unityprogrammerare som vill vara med och utveckla plattformen vidare.

Om rollen

Det här är en renodlad programmeringsroll. Du kommer att jobba i kärnan av plattformens kodbas: arkitektur, rendering, UI och prestanda. Stora mängder geologisk data och 3D-modeller ska laddas snabbt, renderas snyggt och gå att navigera flytande i realtid. Det är den typen av problem du kommer att lösa. Du jobbar nära våra 3D-artister och resten av teamet, men din del är koden.

Vad du kommer att göra

Utveckla nya funktioner i plattformen i Unity och C#, från design av lösningen till färdig, testad kod
Bygga och vidareutveckla plattformens gränssnitt i UI Toolkit
Profilera och optimera rendering, minne och laddtider så att stora datamängder flyter i realtid
Skriva shaders och renderingskod som gör geologisk data tydlig och visuellt övertygande
Bidra till våra interna verktyg och datapipelines (Unity Editor, Blender, databaser, GIS) som gör det snabbare att få in kunddata i plattformen

Vi söker dig som

Har minst tre års arbetslivserfarenhet som programmerare. Bakgrund som spelprogrammerare fungerar bra, bakgrund som system- eller grafikprogrammerare är ännu bättre.
Kan Unity och C# på djupet, det är kärnan i allt vi bygger
Har jobbat med UI Toolkit
Är van att profilera och optimera Unity-applikationer
Skriver shaders. Shader Graph är okej, HLSL eller motsvarande är bättre.
Talar och skriver svenska
Bor i Göteborg eller är redo att flytta hit. Rollen är på plats på kontoret.

Meriterande

God engelska i tal och skrift, eftersom våra kunder är internationella
Webbutveckling och Python
Utveckling för mobila plattformar
Import och hantering av databaser
Egenutvecklade verktyg för Unity Editor
Egenutvecklade verktyg för Blender
GIS

Praktiskt

Placering: Göteborg, på plats
Omfattning: Heltid
Start: Enligt överenskommelse
Du behöver ha rätt att arbeta i Sverige

Ansökan

Vi intervjuar löpande till den här tjänsten, så skicka in din ansökan direkt. Skicka CV, personligt brev och länk till portfolio eller GitHub till jobs@terrahutton.io med ämnesraden "Unityprogrammerare - Göteborg".

Vi vill ha ett personligt brev skrivet av dig
, där du berättar vad du har byggt och varför den här rollen passar dig. Automatiserade ansökningar undanbeds. Har du kod du är stolt över, visa den.

jobs.description:
Har du erfarenhet som lösningsarkitekt inom datalager och analyslösningar? Är du redo för nästa steg i din karriär med möjligheter och flexibilitet som ledord? Vill du skapa riktigt värde genom lösningar inom datalager och analysmodeller? Läs vidare om vårt datadrivna team!

Vem är du?

Du brinner sannolikt lite extra för teknik och ser det därför som en naturlig del att hålla dig uppdaterad om vad som händer och trendar inom teknikens värld.

Genom ditt driv och ansvarstagande ser du till att våra kunder får bästa möjliga lösning som stödjer deras verksamhet. Du är även en prestigelös lagspelare och kan leda olika konstellationer av utvecklingsteam.

Vi söker dig som

har 4-8 års erfarenhet av design och utveckling av BI-lösningar
har erfarenhet av att implementera datalösningar i Azure, exempelvis Azure Synapse, Databricks, Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Microsoft Fabric & Data Vault
har lång erfarenhet av informations- och datamodellering
har hands-on erfarenhet av programmering inom SQL och Python
har arbetat med stora datamängder med distribuerade ramverk, som till exempel spark
har förmåga att översätta kundens unika behov till en arkitektur och implementera denna
har vana att leda dina utvecklar-kollegor med utgångspunkt i både nuläge och målbild av arkitekturen
talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Ett plus om du har erfarenhet av

Data Vault & DBT (Data Build Tool)
Azure, exempelvis Microsoft Fabric
Power BI
ML och AI lösningar

Team Data Driven Transformation - Vilka är vi?

I team Data-Driven Transformation arbetar vi tillsammans med våra kunder för att skapa värde av data, och i sin tur framgångsrika människor och organisationer med tryggare beslutsfattande och effektivare arbetssätt. Vårt mål är att hitta den perfekta mixen av professionalism och entreprenörsanda för att på bästa sätt bidra till våra kunders verksamhet med både kompetens och kreativitet.

Vi agerar rådgivare och teknisk partner inom data-drivna system där vi även designar och implementerar tekniska lösningar för machine learning och advanced analytics. Detta kan till exempel vara att samla, strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data, visuellt designa rapporter och möjliggöra ett mer proaktivt beslutsfattande. Andra exempel är maskininlärningsmodeller för att personifiera innehåll på hemsidor, analysera kundbeteenden samt optimera morgondagens energi och produktionssystem.

Vårt team innehåller en härlig mix av både erfarna förmågor och nyare talanger. Tillsammans skapar vi energi och glädje i både leveranser och interna initiativ. För att sporra och utveckla varandra som både kollegor och konsulter skapar vi tillfällen för både kompetensutveckling på jobbet och sociala aktiviteter i olika former.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Nyfiken?
Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss genom att maila: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Hitachi Energy is a global leader in electrification, powering a sustainable future with innovative grid technologies and digital solutions. We’re inspiring the next era of sustainable energy, making electricity more accessible to all and empowering societies to thrive.

IVRS (Integration, Verification, Release and Support) is a department within Grid Integration Modular Advanced Control (GI MACH), working with securing the quality of the MACH platform, the brain of the HVDC station. We are responsible for verification of the MACH Platform towards high level requirements and for releasing the platform to our customers.

IVRS is developing a robust CI/CD pipeline to revolutionize delivery of the MACH platform in an HVDC project. Join the GI MACH team to help build a next-generation data platform that unifies data from diverse sources, creating a single source of truth for code development, design, and manufacturing.

As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in automating and scaling the infrastructure that powers this platform, with extra focus on our internal applications and tools.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Design, develop, and implement mission-critical tools and applications to support a scalable, high-performance, high-volume production environment with global users.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for C++ and C# development environments, leveraging tools like Azure DevOps, MS Build scripts, Python and build systems.
Automate infrastructure and software processes using tools like Ansible or Terraform.
Manage containerized environments using Docker or Podman including creating and testing Windows and Linux images.
Implement full-stack monitoring and alerting systems using tools like Sensu, Splunk, Logstash or Nagios.
Plan and execute software and infrastructure upgrades based on data-driven capacity planning.
Manage configuration, variants, and version control using Git, TFVC, and release management tools like Jira.
Streamline development experiences for teams by designing scalable CI/CD processes and optimizing workflows with containerization and virtualization.
Collaborate with teams to support business needs and provide domain expertise for internal systems.

Your background

Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Expert skills in Linux, networking, storage, and virtualization.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python. Shell and Golang beneficial.
Strong understanding of CI/CD processes and experience designing pipelines using GitHub or GitLab.
Familiarity with build systems (Makefiles, CMake) or Bazel and release management tools (e.g.: Git).
Ability to manage software and infrastructure upgrades with a focus on scalability and performance.
Experience setting up and supporting development environments for C++ and C#. Embedded system developer background beneficial.
Strong English communication skills, Swedish is advantage.

More About Us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

Our Benefits Offering For Our Roles Generally Includes

Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
Group life insurance and additional insurances.
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)
Health care and wellness allowance
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)
Psychological support program
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Various trainings and education supporting employee development
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.

Har du erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och testa lösningar inom avancerad analys? Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär med möjligheter och utveckling som ledord? Vill du, precis som vi, skapa affärsdrivna end-to-end lösningar som gör verklig skillnad? Då ser vi fram emot att höra ifrån dig!

Vem är du?

Du har ett genuint teknikintresse och drivs av att utvecklas tillsammans med ditt team. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och är nyfiken på att lära dig av andra. Du är trygg i att ta ansvar för uppgifter där du får strukturera och identifiera affärsmässiga samt tekniska mål, och driva arbetet framåt. Du har lätt för att kommunicera resultat till olika målgrupper, oavsett teknisk nivå och du tar gärna ansvar för leveranser från start till mål.

Du är lösningsorienterad och ser alltid till att kunden får den bästa möjliga lösningen. Eftersom tjänsten även innehåller en och annan fika, tror vi att du gillar att nätverka med kollegor och tillsammans utforska nya idéer, erbjudanden och tjänster. Du är en lagspelare som gärna stöttar dina kollegor när behov uppstår.

Du brinner för att designa, implementera och agera rådgivare inom datalösningar för avancerad analys. Med en operativ inställning omfamnar du DevOps/MLOps och har ett starkt fokus på automation och end-to-end ägarskap.

Vi vill jobba med dig som

har 3+ års erfarenhet av design, utveckling och testning av avancerade BI-lösningar.
har erfarenhet av att implementera lösningar i exempelvis Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake & Snowflake.
har hands-on erfarenhet av programmering inom SQL och Python.
har erfarenhet av att hantera stora datamängder med hjälp av distribuerade ramverk, såsom Apache Spark, för att möjliggöra skalbar och effektiv databehandling.
behärskar svenska och engelska.
har erfarenhet av att utveckla Power BI-rapporter.

Ett plus om du har erfarenhet av

Data Vault
DBT (Data Build Tool)
Machine Learning och AI lösningar

Vårt team

I teamet Data-Driven Transformation samarbetar vi nära med våra kunder för att omvandla data till konkret värde vilket leder till tryggare beslut, effektivare arbetssätt och framgångsrika organisationer.

Vår ambition är att kombinera professionalism och entreprenörsanda och därigenom bidra med både kompetens och kreativitet. Vi strävar efter att vara en partner som inte bara levererar lösningar, utan också inspirerar till utveckling.

Vi är både rådgivare och teknisk partner inom data-drivna system, från design till implementation av lösningar för såväl avancerad analys som machine learning. Det kan handla om att samla in, strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data, skapa visuella rapporter eller möjliggöra mer proaktivt beslutsfattande.

Vårt team innehåller en dynamisk mix av erfarna experter och nya talanger, vilket skapar både energi och arbetsglädje i våra leveranser och interna initiativ. Vi tror på att växa tillsammans genom kompetensutveckling, kunskapsdelning och sociala aktiviteter som stärker både teamkänsla och konsultrollen.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Nyfiken?
Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

GM’s Motorsports Software team analyzes, defines, and delivers next-generation, groundbreaking Motorsports IT software solutions. Using innovative cloud-based infrastructure and modern software development standards, these solutions enable seamless interaction between GM Global Engineering, GM Motorsports, and our race teams—helping accelerate our drivers to the finish line first.

In this role, you will lead and contribute to the delivery of complex software projects, developing applications using a variety of tools, languages, frameworks, and technologies. In this role, you will lead and contribute to the delivery of complex software projects, developing applications using a variety of tools, languages, frameworks, and technologies. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Database Migration Service
jobs.description:
Description

Database Migration for Amazon RDS is fully managed, serverless capability that enables customers to migrate SQL Server/Oracle workloads - whether running on Amazon RDS, Amazon EC2, on-premises infrastructure, or other cloud providers - to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Customers simply provide source and target connection details, and the service orchestrates the entire migration lifecycle end-to-end: pre-migration assessment, schema conversion, data movement.

In addition to a traditional console-driven experience, the service introduces an agentic migration workflow. Customers can initiate and manage migrations through natural language within the developer tools they already use - such as Kiro, Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. The AI agent assesses the source environment, converts the schema, moves the data, validates the outcome - removing friction and reducing the expertise required to complete complex database migrations.

Amazon RDS is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations - from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement scalable, serverless microservices that power the migration lifecycle - assessment, schema conversion, data movement;
Develop intelligent, agent-driven migration workflows that integrate with modern developer tools and leverage natural language interfaces;
Own the end-to-end migration lifecycle - from pre-migration assessment and schema conversion through data movement phases;
Solve hard distributed systems challenges around reliability, security, and performance for customers migrating their most critical production workloads;
Work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and AI/ML to deliver a seamless, low-friction migration experience that removes traditional barriers to database modernization;
Mentor SDE Is through code reviews, design guidance, and pair programming;
Participate in on-call rotations and operational excellence initiatives.

A day in the life

You might start the day with participating in a design review for a new feature: parallel data movement for multi-terabyte databases. You whiteboard trade-offs between consistency guarantees and throughput, debating how to minimize downtime during cutover windows. Later, you pair with a teammate to debug a race condition in the serverless orchestration layer that surfaces only under high concurrency.

About The Team

You'll join a team of curious, driven engineers who believe that technical excellence and world-class reliability are not aspirations - they are the baseline our customers deserve. If you want to build something that matters, alongside people who challenge and inspire you, this is the place.

This is a rare opportunity to design and operate systems at true cloud scale while developing deep expertise across three of the most transformative domains in modern engineering: cloud computing, database technologies, and artificial intelligence.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
Experience in professional, non-internship software development
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
Experience in development in the last 3 years

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

PM Group is looking for a Test Automation Engineer to join our team. We are seeking a Test Automation Engineer with proven experience working in a GMP-regulated environment to design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for computerized systems supporting GxP operations. The role partners with software engineering, QA, validation, and business owners to build sustainable automation that accelerates release cycles while preserving full regulatory compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and GAMP 5 expectations

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, and integration) for GxP applications including MES, LIMS, ERP, QMS, and laboratory/manufacturing systems.
Author and execute test scripts within a validated test management ecosystem (e.g., Robot Framework, Tricentis Tosca, TestComplete, Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, UFT) integrated with test management tools (Xray for Jira, Azure DevOps Test Plans, Polarion, Jenkins pipelines).
Produce GxP-compliant test documentation: test plans, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols, test scripts, traceability matrices, defect reports, and summary reports — aligned to GAMP 5 risk-based testing.
Support Computer System Validation (CSV) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) activities, including requirements traceability, risk assessment, and electronic records / electronic signatures (ERES) controls per 21 CFR Part 11.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab) with appropriate change-control gates so automation is itself qualified and version-controlled.
Partner with developers, business analysts, and validation engineers to shift testing left, define acceptance criteria as Gherkin scenarios (Given/When/Then), and ensure data integrity (ALCOA+) is preserved across test environments.
Investigate test failures, perform root-cause analysis, log deviations where required, and support CAPA activities related to test escapes and validation findings.
Maintain test environments, test data (including masked/synthetic GxP data), and reusable automation libraries; champion code reviews and framework standards.
Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA) by presenting automation strategy, evidence, and validation artifacts.

Essential Skills & Experience

Minimum 3–5 years' test automation experience, with at least 2 years in a GMP / GxP-regulated environment (pharma, biotech, medical devices, or CDMO).
Working knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, and data integrity principles (ALCOA+).
Hands-on proficiency with at least one enterprise automation tool (Robot Framework, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium/WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress, TestComplete, or UFT) and one scripting/programming language (Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
Experience automating API tests (REST/SOAP) using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate.
Demonstrable experience with BDD using Gherkin syntax (Given/When/Then) and frameworks such as Cucumber, SpecFlow, Behave, or Robot Framework — including authoring feature files collaboratively with business and validation stakeholders.
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and source control (Git).
Proven track record producing audit-ready validation deliverables (IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability matrices, test summary reports).
Strong understanding of SDLC and V-model / Agile-in-validated-environments delivery.
Excellent written communication — able to author protocols and defect reports that withstand regulatory scrutiny.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience).
Relevant certifications welcomed: ISTQB, Tricentis, GAMP, or Lean Six Sigma.

Key Competencies

Quality and compliance mindset — defaults to documented, traceable work.
Analytical problem-solver with strong attention to detail.
Effective collaborator across IT, QA, validation, and business stakeholders.
Pragmatic — balances regulatory rigor with delivery velocity.

Continuous learner; keeps current with evolving guidance (CSA, AI/ML in GxP).

A technically varied full-stack role across backend and frontend development
An international product team with skilled colleagues across several European locations
Opportunities to influence technical solutions, architecture and engineering practices
Training and development opportunities tailored to your professional goals
Access to company-sponsored certifications and relevant learning activities
A hybrid working model based on the role, location and business needs
An inclusive environment with professional and social meeting places

We believe strong software is built by people who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other improve. You will receive responsibility and room to contribute, with a team around you when the problems become difficult.

Atea works with technology that supports organisations and the people who depend on it. Behind every reliable solution are people who develop, test, improve and support it together.

As part of Atea, you will join a wider professional community with opportunities to learn, share experience and develop your skills. We believe in giving people responsibility while making sure they have colleagues and expertise around them.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Vi er på utkikk etter flere dedikerte systemutviklere som kan utvikle innovative løsninger for kundene våre.

Våre avdelinger i Ålesund og Ørsta er nordvestlandets største konsulentmiljø. Vi tør påstå at vi har regionens mest spennende kunder, og langvarige relasjoner som sikrer stadig påfyll av utviklende prosjekter. Sammen med våre 2500 kollegaer i Twoday får du muligheten til å jobbe på Sunnmøre, med nasjonale kunder av alle størrelser. Her er et lite utvalg av det vi gjør:

Fremtidens skip: Sammen med VARD jobber vi med å forberede avanserte skip for fjernstyring og autonom kjøring.
Utdeling av samfunnsbidrag: Vi jobber sammen med Sparebanken Møre for å effektivisere prosessen der lag og foreninger kan søke om å få tildelt støtte til samfunnsnyttige bidrag.
Sjøsikkerhet: For Kystverket analyserer vi data om skipstrafikk, vær & sjøforhold, og hjelper dermed å holde havområdene våre trygge.

Vi ser etter deg som har:

Minimum 5 års relevant erfaring. Det er en fordel om du har vært konsulent tidligere, men ikke et krav.
Kompetanse innen enten backendutvikling med .NET/C# eller Java, eller frontendutvikling med erfaring fra moderne rammeverk og teknologier.
Erfaring med skybaserte løsninger i AWS og/eller Azure.
Du bruker AI aktivt i utviklingsarbeidet og er nysgjerrig på hvordan teknologien kan omsettes til konkrete kundeløsninger.
Det er også supert om du har erfaring med smidig arbeidsmetodikk, automatisering av bygg og testing.
Gode norskferdigheter, både skriftlig og muntlig.

Hvorfor Twoday?

I Twoday jobber du sammen med flinke folk som bryr seg, både om faget og om hverandre. Vi er rause i måten vi samarbeider på, det er lav terskel for å spørre om hjelp, utfordre ideer og lære underveis. Trivsel hos oss handler ikke bare om spennende oppdrag, men om å være del av et miljø der folk blir værende over tid. I dag er 35 % av kollegene våre og over halvparten av lederne kvinner. Dette er vi stolte av i en bransje som ofte ser annerledes ut.

Du blir en del av et bredt og inkluderende fagmiljø med aktiv kunnskapsdeling på tvers av teamene i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Finland og Litauen. Vi legger til rette for faglig utvikling gjennom faggrupper, fagkvelder, kurs og sertifiseringer. Hos oss skal det også være mulig å vokse over tid, og å ta initiativ utover eget ansvarsområde. Det kan være innen fagansvar, arkitektur, team- eller teknologiledelse, eller i mer tverrfaglige og globale roller.

Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, fleksibilitet i arbeidshverdagen og høy grad av tillit. Du får rom til å styre egen hverdag innenfor teamets og kundens rammer, mulighet for Hive Jumping mellom et av våre kontorer i våre fem land, og mulighet for medeierskap i selskapet. Hos oss skal det være mulig å gjøre en god jobb og samtidig ha et godt liv ved siden av.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Vi tar gjerne en prat, uavhengig av om du aktivt er på jobbsøk eller bare er nysgjerrig på å høre mer om hvordan vi jobber og hva vi kan tilby.

Oppfyller du ikke alle kravene nevnt ovenfor?

I Twoday ønsker vi å skape et arbeidsmiljø der folk føler seg velkomne og trygge på å være seg selv. Hvis denne rollen høres interessant ut for deg, men du ikke kjenner deg igjen i absolutt alle punktene i stillingsbeskrivelsen, oppfordrer vi deg likevel til å ta kontakt eller sende inn en søknad.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101130

Help Shape How Cities Are Designed

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join us in developing the next generation of our AI-powered architecture design platform. Your contributions will have a direct impact on the quality and capability of our product. You'll work on systems that combine cloud architecture, performance-sensitive applications, and AI to support complex design and simulation workflows.

Your work will enable architects, planners, and developers to discover smarter, more sustainable solutions and gain meaningful insights into their projects.

About Us

We’re on a mission to help design better cities.

With 90% of future population growth expected in urban areas, and construction responsible for around 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. Our cloud-based Autodesk Forma platform helps users evaluate design choices based on environmental impact, living quality (sun, daylight, noise), and project feasibility. We started as Spacemaker in Norway and became part of Autodesk in 2020.

Learn more about Autodesk Forma here.

How We Work

We work in small, autonomous teams with a high degree of trust and ownership. We strongly believe in servant leadership and team accountability. In each team, software engineers work closely together with product managers and designers. To learn more about our way of working, read through our tech and product core beliefs.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will deliver high-quality work and contribute to technical decisions within your team, while increasing your impact through ownership of complex features and systems.

In This Role, You Will

Contribute to technical direction within your team and provide input on architectural decisions
Take ownership of complex features and systems, driving their design and delivery end-to-end
Contribute to technical planning within your team and help align work with product goals
Navigate trade-offs between performance, cost, and user experience in complex workflows
Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver meaningful user outcomes
Share knowledge and support the growth of your teammates

Desired profile

Works independently on complex problems and navigates ambiguity within your domain
Takes ownership of technical decisions within your team and contributes to broader architectural conversations
Strong expertise in your primary domain with growing breadth across related technologies
Collaborates effectively and helps teammates grow
Proactively identifies and acts on improvements within your scope
Collaborates across functions to align engineering with product and user outcomes
Motivated by our mission and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes at scale

Areas of expertise that might resonate with you

You get your energy from building the foundations other people rely on, pulling systems apart into simple, observable pieces, owning something in production long enough to feel responsible for it, and reaching for the boring, reliable option before building something new.
You're drawn to problems where the math is the hard part, geometry, simulation, optimization, and you like taking a model from "this is the theory" to something that runs reliably on real inputs and matches what users expect to see.
You start from the user and the problem, not the ticket. You are comfortable with a fuzzy brief and a blank repo, shipping fast to learn, and shaping what gets built as much as how it gets built.

What Will Help You Succeed In This Role

Strong hands-on engineering background building cloud-based, user-facing systems
Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines and seniority levels
Experience with Agentic AI

You might also bring

Experience with TypeScript, serverless architectures and AWS
Background in large-scale systems or platform development
Experience working in cross-functional, international product teams
Experience with 3D graphics, WebGL/WebGPU, or real-time rendering in the browser
Experience with computational geometry, spatial algorithms, or CAD/BIM data models

Why join us

Work on real-world problems with measurable environmental impact
Shape technical direction at a platform level
Collaborate with experienced engineers across disciplines
Competitive compensation, pension, and benefits

We believe diverse teams build better products, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where people can be themselves and do their best work. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement listed. Curiosity, empathy, and a growth mindset matter just as much to us.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

jobs.description:
Oletko kokenut ohjelmistokehittäjä, joka on huomannut käyttävänsä yhä enemmän aikaa teknisten ratkaisujen suunnitteluun, arkkitehtuurin hahmottamiseen tai muiden kehittäjien sparraamiseen?

Haemme
Digian Customer Applications & Power Platform (CA&PP) -yksikköön osaajaa, joka haluaa ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallaan kohti teknistä arkkitehtiroolia. Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis arkkitehti, mutta toivomme, että sinulla on jo kokemusta teknisistä päätöksistä, ratkaisujen suunnittelusta sekä kokonaisuuksien hahmottamisesta.

CA&PP-yksikössämme työskentelee yli 80 Power Platform- ja Dynamics 365 -osaajaa. Meitä yhdistää vahva asiantuntijuus, auttamisen kulttuuri sekä halu rakentaa asiakkaille aidosti lisäarvoa tuottavia ratkaisuja.

Työskentelemme hybridimallilla ja se tarkoittaa meille sitä, että digialaisilla on vapaus valita työskentelypaikkansa viitenä päivänä viikossa työn ja työyhteisön tarpeet huomioiden.

Mitä pääset tekemään?

Tässä roolissa yhdistyvät käytännön kehitystyö ja kasvava vastuu teknisestä suunnittelusta.

Pääset esimerkiksi:

suunnittelemaan Power Platform- ja Dynamics 365 -ratkaisujen teknisiä toteutuksia
osallistumaan arkkitehtuurien, integraatioiden ja ratkaisukokonaisuuksien mallintamiseen
Rakentamaan tekoälyratkaisuja asiakkaille
sparraamaan kehittäjiä teknisissä ratkaisuissa
tekemään edelleen hands-on-kehitystä osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan
osallistumaan asiakaskeskusteluihin ja teknisten vaihtoehtojen arviointiin
vaikuttamaan siihen, miten ratkaisuja rakennetaan nyt ja tulevaisuudessa
seuraamaan Microsoft-ekosysteemin kehitystä ja tuomaan uusia mahdollisuuksia osaksi asiakasratkaisuja

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla pitkäaikaista kokemusta arkkitehtina. Sen sijaan arvostamme kokemusta ja kiinnostusta tekniseen suunnitteluun.

Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemusta ainakin osasta seuraavista:

Power Platformista (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Dynamics 365 -ratkaisuista
JavaScriptista ja/tai C#:sta (esimerkiksi pluginit)
integraatioista ja Azure-palveluista
DevOps- ja ALM-käytännöistä
teknisten ratkaisujen suunnittelusta, dokumentoinnista tai arkkitehtuurikuvausten laatimisesta
tekoälytyökalujen hyödyntämisestä omassa työssä
muiden kehittäjien tukemisesta tai teknisestä ohjaamisesta

Työssä tarvitset hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Tämä rooli sopii erinomaisesti sinulle, joka haluat kasvaa kohti teknistä arkkitehtuuria kokeneiden ammattilaisten ympäröimänä.

Tarjoamme:

mahdollisuuden rakentaa omaa polkuasi senior developerista kohti teknistä arkkitehtiroolia.
Oppimista tukevan kulttuurin. Sinulle varataan viikoittain aikaa uuden oppimisen ja teknologioihin syventymiseen eli työarjessasi on väljyyttä.
Mentorointia ja tukea kokeneilta arkkitehdeilta ja kehittäjiltä. Myös toimitustiimien ja heimojen kautta osaamista jaetaan työajalla.
Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa roolisi sisältöön ja urapolkuusi.
Erinomaiset työsuhde-edut, kuten kattavat työterveyspalvelut, loma-ajan mökit, 2000 euron rekrytointibonuksen jne.
OpenClub-yhteisöt: leffat, padel, käsityöt, lautapelit, kahvihifistely, viinit, uinti… löydät varmasti omasi!

Räätälöimme lopullisen roolin osaamisesi, kokemuksesi ja uratoiveidesi mukaan.

Hakuaika päättyy 11.10.2026.

jobs.title: Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM (frontend/backend udvikler) - genopslag
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Clever arbejder vi for en verden, der kører på el. Lige nu har vi brug for dig, der vil være med til at bygge og udvikle Dynamics 365 CRM-løsninger, som er med til at gøre det nemmere for vores kunder at vælge el i hverdagen.

Din rolle

Rollen er en frontend-udvikler med forståelse for backend udvikling. En rolle, der har et ben i begge lejre, som vil være med til at bygge og sætte retningslinjer for udviklingskomponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Vi drømmer om dig, der vil være med til at bygge centrale komponenter med mange aftagere. Vi arbejder med et system, der er bredt anvendt og hyppigt videreudvikles, så du vil indgå i dialoger med mange interne interessenter. Med andre ord er de rammer, vi sætter i CRM-platform teamet ikke kun vigtige for os, men også for andre udviklingsteams’ arbejde med platformen. Konkret vil du operere med frontend komponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

I dagligdagen anvender vi PCF, typescript og custom pages mv. for at understøtte forretningens processer i CRM.

Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen ”frontend-udvikler”, er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil ”Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM” – for det er netop det, du er.

Din hverdag

Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:

Udvikling af React, Typescript-baserede komponenter og custom pages i CRM.
Dialoger om optimal anvendelse af teknologi og principper inden for udvikling
Planlægning af projekter
Monitorering og drift af vores systemer
Samarbejde med fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kollegaer, der alle har samme mål for øje

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har god erfaring med React og Typescript, og at du har arbejdet med Dynamics CRM før. Du har prøvet at bygge centrale systemer med mange aftagere, hvor du har mærket, hvad der skal til for, at de fremstår robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige.

Erfaring med udvikling af frontend-komponenter i Dynamics CRM
Brænder for gode UI/UX-oplevelser i Dynamics CRM
Erfaring med React eller andet frontend framework
Erfaring med integrationer og kommunikation mellem systemer
Erfaring med C# og .Net og forståelse for backend-udvikling er et plus

Hvem bliver dine legekammerater?

Du vil blive en del af CRM-platform teamet , hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, og derfor primært befinder os på vores kontor.

Vi er seks fuldtidsansatte og en studentermedhjælper. Det vil sige en platforms- og strategiansvarlig, to Dynamics platformsspecialister, en koordinator, en release manager samt vores cloudarkitekt- og backendudvikler. Dine tætteste kollegaer vil primært være i dit eget team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen med et andet CRM-team.

Derudover er der gode muligheder for at skabe netværk og samarbejde med andre frontend-udviklere i Clever.

Medledelseskompetencer (vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes)  

Du tager naturligt ansvar for både dig selv og dine kollegaer, med omsorg og nærvær  
Du er en holdspiller, der ser arbejde som et samarbejde, ikke en konkurrence  
Du holder dit ego i skak og ved, at succes handler om at løfte i flok mod fælles mål 

Har du sat mentale flueben hele vejen igennem?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Finder vi det rette match, kan vi finde på at lukke opslaget før fristen. Så hvis du tænker, at det her job er det rigtige for dig, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, så du er sikker på at komme i betragtning. Vi håber, at vi gennem din ansøgning kan lære dig at kende og se, hvad du kan bidrage med. Det er fint, hvis du bruger AI-værktøjer til inspiration – men husk at personliggøre din ansøgning, da vi leder efter hele mennesker. Vi modtager kun ansøgninger igennem vores hjemmeside.

Du kan læse mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på: www.clever.dk/velkommen eller vores Instagramkonto @liveticlever. Er du nysgerrig på vores rekrutteringsproces kan du læse mere om den her: Rekrutteringsprocessen i Clever | Clever .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Computerized Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Department

IT & Automation, Drug Substance Manufacturing, Global Manufacturing & Supply

Location

Kalundborg, Denmark. Your main base is close to the manufacturing sites. Travel to partner locations in the Copenhagen area may occur on an ad hoc basis but is not a regular work location.

Your impact begins here

As a Computerized Systems Engineer, you keep the computerized equipment, smart instruments and IT/OT systems behind large-scale drug substance production running reliably and in a validated, GMP-compliant state. Your work supports consistent, stable operations that colleagues in production depend on every day—helping ensure the medicines people living with serious chronic diseases rely on can be made safely and on time.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a proactive, collaborative colleague who is eager to develop within computerized systems, digital manufacturing and IT/OT support in a GMP-regulated environment.

Essential

A B.Sc., M.Sc., AP Degree or similar within IT, Engineering, Automation, Instrumentation, Computer Science or a related technical field.
Full professional proficiency in English, written and spoken.
An interest in learning GMP requirements and maintaining systems in a validated environment.
A structured, solution-oriented approach, ownership of your tasks and genuine enjoyment of working with different stakeholders.

Useful, But Not Essential

Experience from IT, automation, instrumentation, manufacturing support, laboratory systems or technical support functions. Recent graduates with relevant internships, student jobs or project work are also encouraged to apply.
Knowledge of manufacturing processes or experience from a regulated industry.
Experience with incident and change management, user administration, system maintenance, SOPs, backup and recovery, or supplier coordination.
Familiarity with validation, data integrity, IT security, risk assessments, infrastructure or computerized systems lifecycle management.

What You'll Do

You'll help secure reliable, compliant operations across production by maintaining the systems that keep manufacturing moving. In practice, you will:

Maintain and support computerized equipment, smart instruments and related IT components to ensure availability, reliability and operational stability.
Contribute to ongoing process validation (OPV) and periodic reviews, and manage Operation and Maintenance SOPs through their full lifecycle.
Support incident, problem, deviation and change management, and coordinate patching, upgrades, backup, recovery, restore planning and user access in line with quality and validation requirements.
Identify IT and computerized equipment risks and complete IT risk assessments covering security, data integrity, infrastructure, coding/configuration, smart instruments and operational support.
Safeguard data integrity for electronic data generated, processed, stored or transferred by computerized equipment and smart instruments.

Who You'll Work With

You'll join the IT & Automation Department—a diverse team of colleagues from many nationalities and professional backgrounds. The atmosphere is inclusive and collaborative: people support each other in finding answers and share the load across tasks. Because project life moves fast, the team is dynamic and ready to shift priorities to hit important milestones.

You'll work closely with stakeholders across manufacturing, quality and validation in Kalundborg, and with collaboration partners based around Copenhagen. Together, you'll keep the project running with clarity and speed.

What You Can Expect Here

You'll work in one of the strongest IT and Automation environments in the pharmaceutical industry, with real scope to build new skills across computerized systems, digital manufacturing and GMP-regulated IT/OT support. Whether you're an experienced engineer or a recent graduate, you'll be trusted to take ownership, encouraged to make your voice heard and supported to grow.

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the annual base salary ranges from DKK 499,600 to DKK 734,400 corresponding to the level of the position. The role is open to candidates with varying levels of experience, and placement within the range is assessed during recruitment based on your skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you're ready to keep large-scale drug substance production running reliably and compliantly, apply for the Computerized Systems Engineer role by 23 September 2026.

For further information about the position, please contact Tinne Bonde at THEB@novonordisk.com

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.
Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.
Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.
Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.
Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.
Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

You’re a great match if

You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team
You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off
You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them
You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team
You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

Nice to have

Experience working on live games

Requirements For Any Job At Triband

You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward
You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture
You value a positive work environment
You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

Practicalities

Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen
Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role
37-hour work week, with flexible work hours
No crunch, we put people before deadlines
Our working language is English

We offer

Silly but ambitious projects
The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games
A professional development budget to invest in your growth
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).
Six weeks of paid vacation
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked
Pension plan and private health insurance
Endless amounts of coffee

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Aspen MES Programmer with 15+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting AspenTech Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions in regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environments. This is a senior technical and advisory role for an individual who has led complex MES implementations end-to-end, mentored junior engineers, and served as the go-to subject matter expert for Aspen MES architecture, integration, and validation strategy. Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Serve as the senior technical authority and architect for Aspen MES / Aspen InfoPlus.21 (IP.21) solutions across one or more manufacturing sites, defining system architecture, standards, and best practices.
Lead the design and configuration of complex electronic batch records (EBRs), recipe management structures, equipment models, and unit procedures for high-complexity or multi-product manufacturing lines.
Own the technical roadmap for MES platform evolution, including upgrade strategy, capacity planning, and long-term architecture decisions across the Aspen MOM/MES suite (Aspen MES, Aspen PEM, Aspen Enterprise Historian).
Evaluate emerging AspenTech capabilities and industry trends (Industry 4.0, MES/MOM convergence, cloud-enabled historians) and advise leadership on adoption strategy.

Development, Integration & Delivery

Lead full lifecycle delivery of large-scale MES projects: requirements definition, functional/technical design, configuration, custom scripting, integration, testing, validation, and go-live support.
Architect and oversee complex integrations between Aspen MES and DCS/SCADA/PLC systems (e.g., DeltaV, PCS7), ERP platforms (SAP, including SAP MII/PI-PO), LIMS, warehouse management, and serialization/track-and-trace systems.
Design and review advanced scripts, calculations, and custom reports using Aspen MES scripting tools, SQL, and supporting languages (VB.NET, C#, Python) to extend platform capability.
Direct and review the work of junior and mid-level MES programmers/engineers, providing technical mentorship, code/configuration review, and knowledge transfer.
Lead root-cause analysis and resolution for the most complex, cross-system production issues and data integrity discrepancies, minimizing manufacturing downtime.

Quality, Compliance & Validation

Own and drive computer system validation (CSV) strategy for MES projects in accordance with GAMP 5, authoring and approving URS, FS, DS, and IQ/OQ/PQ documentation.
Ensure all MES architecture, configuration, and development activities comply with 21 CFR Part 11, GMP, and data integrity (ALCOA+) principles.
Serve as the senior MES representative in audits, regulatory inspections, and internal quality reviews, providing technical justification and remediation plans as needed.
Lead change control activities for significant MES configuration changes, including impact assessments, risk analysis, and cross-functional approval coordination.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

Partner with Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Automation/OT, IT, and Validation leadership to support new product introductions, technology transfers, and site expansions.
Act as primary technical liaison with AspenTech (or implementation partners) for escalations, licensing, upgrade planning, and roadmap alignment.
Present technical strategies, risk assessments, and project status to senior management and stakeholders.
Develop and deliver advanced training programs for engineering staff, operators, and quality personnel on MES functionality and best practices.

Required Qualifications

15+ years of progressive, hands-on experience developing, architecting, and supporting AspenTech MES (Aspen MES / Aspen InfoPlus.21 / Aspen Production Execution Manager) within regulated pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences manufacturing environments.
Demonstrated experience leading full-cycle MES implementations, including greenfield deployments and multi-site rollouts.
Deep expertise in electronic batch record (EBR) design, recipe/procedure modeling, and complex production workflow configuration.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle) for data architecture, reporting, and troubleshooting.
Strong working knowledge of automation/control systems (PLC, SCADA, DCS) and OT/IT integration architecture.
Expert-level understanding of GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and computer system validation (CSV) methodology, with a track record of leading validation efforts.
Proven experience managing change control, deviation investigations, and CAPA related to MES systems.
Demonstrated ability to mentor and lead technical teams, and to communicate effectively with senior leadership, quality, and regulatory stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills for complex, multi-system, business-critical issues.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Aspen Production Execution Manager (PEM), Aspen Enterprise Historian, or the broader AspenTech Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) suite.
Experience architecting MES-to-ERP integrations (SAP MII, PI/PO, or equivalent middleware) at an enterprise scale.
Advanced scripting/programming experience in VB.NET, C#, or Python for platform extension and automation.
Experience in sterile/aseptic processing, biologics, solid dose, or combination product manufacturing.
Working knowledge of ISA-95 / ISA-88 standards and their application in enterprise MES architecture.
Experience leading serialization/track-and-trace integration initiatives.

The Senior Software Test Engineer will help ensure quality, security, release readiness, and platform stability for B2B IAM applications. This process not only ensures compliance but also provides the team with a deep understanding of regional business landscapes and cross-functional collaboration, enabling us to drive long-term, impactful solutions as the organization grows.

Job Description

Design and implement workflow‑based control automation for Regulatory Standards (e.g., ISO, PCI) and SOX 404 ITGCs, using:
Explicit start–action–evidence–end flows.
Triggers from tickets, change‑management systems, HR events, or IAM changes.
Delivered via tools such as n8n, Camunda, Azure Logic Apps, or custom MCP‑style servers.

Build and operate MCP‑style or MCP‑compatible servers that expose:
Tools: RESTful endpoints for “trigger evidence collection”, “run access review”, “validate change ticket”, etc..
Resources: Standardized data sources (logs, IAM, ticket data) formatted for AI agents or workflow engines.
Auth patterns: API keys, bearer tokens, OAuth2, or OIDC‑style flows that can be consumed by agents or external tools.

Engineer API‑first automation:
Write scripts and connectors (Python, Node.js, Bash, etc.) that call, compose, and orchestrate APIs from:
IAM, IdP, PAM, HRIS, ticketing, cloud IAM, and logging platforms, etc.
GRC platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, 6clicks, or similar) via REST APIs.

Implement:
Authentication and authorization (API keys, Bearer, OAuth2, JWT, Basic, MTLS).
Pagination, retry with backoff, rate‑limiting, and safe error handling.
Idempotency and safe state transitions for audit‑critical operations.

Translate ISO 27001 controls and SOX 404 ITGCs into automated workflows:
Example pattern:
Trigger: new user join or role change in IAM.
Action: call APIs to validate entitlements, cross‑check against SoD, and emit evidence to a GRC tool.
Outcome: workflow‑generated record for ISO 27001 access control and SOX logical‑access control.

Maintain one source of truth for control logic (code / config) and use workflow IDs as control‑evidence bindings.

Design AI‑agent‑ready interfaces:
Expose structured, MCP‑style endpoints or OpenAPI specs so that LLM agents or workflow tools can call concrete tools (e.g., “get latest access review for System X”, “run change‑ticket‑completeness check”).
Handle dynamic policy enforcement: short‑lived tokens, context‑aware access, and audit logging for each AI or agent call.

Integrate with data platforms and SIEM/logging:
Use logs, change tickets, and identity events as workflow inputs.
Build automated tests for control effectiveness (e.g., “if a production change is not approved, fire an alert and record as control failure”) linked to ISO / SOX control IDs.

Maintain audit‑ready workflow artifacts:
Log all workflow steps, including timestamps, input, user/agent context, and outputs.
Ensure workflow outputs are machinable (JSON, structured logs) and can be replayed or reasoned over by auditors or AI agents.

Requirements

Students currently pursuing Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering or related disciplines.
Strong understanding of authorization and authentication:
API keys, Bearer tokens, OAuth2 (client, JWT, PKCE), Basic Auth, MTLS, and OIDC‑style flows.
Hands‑on experience implementing these in Python, Node.js, or Go (or similar).

Deep practical experience with:
RESTful APIs: understanding of HTTP methods, status codes, pagination, rate‑limiting, and idempotency.
API clients: writing or using libraries that handle auth, retries, and error handling for large datasets.

Experience building or integrating with:
Workflow / orchestration tools (n8n, Airflow, Logic Apps, Camunda, etc.) or MCP‑style servers / Model Context Protocol‑compatible tooling.
GRC platforms via APIs (e.g., ServiceNow, 6clicks, or similar).

Familiarity with:
ISO 27001 (especially Annex A controls related to access management, change control, and operations).
SOX 404 ITGCs (logical access, change management, computer operations, data integrity).

Full-time interns preferred
Part-time interns who can commit at least 3 working days a week are also welcome to apply

Preferred Qualifications
