En plena fase de rápido crecimiento y transformación constante, el grupo se ha consolidado como un referente en la industria del software, impulsado por la fortaleza de unos equipos decididos, audaces y comprometidos.

En Septeo, la inteligencia artificial es el eje de nuestra evolución. La entendemos como un motor de rendimiento sostenible, colaboración e innovación, integrada de manera responsable en las prácticas cotidianas y democratizada en todas nuestras áreas de negocio. Nuestra ambición es clara: «crear software inteligente para Europa».

Nuestra cultura se cimenta en valores sólidos: ser, hacer y transformar juntos. No es una cultura estática; se vive día a día en nuestras acciones y decisiones, logrando un equilibrio entre rendimiento, responsabilidad y disfrute.

Esta ambición se refleja en nuestra labor diaria: diseñar software que acompaña los momentos esenciales de la vida, al servicio de millones de ciudadanos. Desempeñar un papel en estos momentos clave conlleva una gran responsabilidad. Es una responsabilidad que asumimos con orgullo y que pronto podría ser también la tuya.

Unirse a Septeo significa formar parte de un proyecto colectivo internacional, impulsar la transformación del grupo en un entorno de rápida evolución y convertir la IA en un motor tangible de creación de valor, tanto en el presente como en el futuro.

Descripción del empleo

How You’ll Have Impact

Build the Platform Behind the Platform: Design and evolve the cloud infrastructure that powers our multi-tenant SaaS ecosystem.
Enable Engineering Velocity: Improve CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and deployment automation.
Drive Reliability & Observability: Ensure high availability, performance, and real-time visibility across distributed systems.
Architect for Scale: Design infrastructure that supports growth, AI workloads, and distributed services.
Champion Infrastructure as Code: Everything reproducible, versioned, and automated.
Embed Security by Design: Implement DevSecOps best practices across the delivery lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure.
Manage and optimize containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or equivalent).
Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.
Improve monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (ELK stack, Grafana dashboards and alerting, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools).
Operate, monitor, and tune Microsoft SQL Server databases (performance, backups, high availability).
Optimize system performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate closely with backend engineers (Java / Kotlin, C#, Node.js) to improve deployment patterns and runtime reliability.
Automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.
Leverage AI-assisted tooling (Claude, Codex, automation agents, anomaly detection systems) to improve operational efficiency.
Participate in architectural discussions to ensure infrastructure scalability and resilience.

You don’t just maintain infrastructure — you engineer the reliability of the business.

Cloud Building Blocks: AWS & Azure

We Run Workloads On Both AWS And Azure. We Are Looking For Solid Hands-on Experience With IaaS And Core Managed Cloud Services On At Least One Of Them — Knowing The Equivalent On The Other Cloud Is a Strong Plus. These Are The Building Blocks You’ll Work With

Virtual machines & autoscaling — Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets | AWS: Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups
Virtual networking — Azure: VNet, NSGs, VNet Integration, Private Endpoints | AWS: VPC, Security Groups, PrivateLink
L7 load balancing + WAF — Azure: Application Gateway + WAF | AWS: Application Load Balancer + AWS WAF
Web app / API hosting — Azure: App Service | AWS: Elastic Beanstalk / App Runner
Managed Kubernetes — Azure: AKS | AWS: EKS
Message queues — Azure: Azure Storage — Queues | AWS: Amazon SQS
Object storage — Azure: Azure Storage — Blobs | AWS: Amazon S3
In-memory cache — Azure: Azure Cache for Redis | AWS: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey)
Managed SQL Server — Azure: Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance | AWS: Amazon RDS for SQL Server
Workload identity (secretless auth) — Azure: Managed Identity + DefaultAzureCredential | AWS: IAM Roles (instance profiles, IRSA) + SDK default credential chain
Secrets & keys — Azure: Key Vault | AWS: AWS Secrets Manager / KMS
Transactional email — Azure: Azure Communication Services (Email) | AWS: Amazon SES
Per-environment configuration — Azure: App Settings | AWS: Systems Manager Parameter Store / AppConfig
Logs, metrics & alerts — Azure: Log Analytics / Azure Monitor | AWS: Amazon CloudWatch
Runtime diagnostics — Azure: Kudu / App Service diagnostics | AWS: CloudWatch Logs Insights / SSM Session Manager

Requisitos

5+ years of experience in DevOps / Cloud Engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience with AWS or Azure — experience with both is a strong plus.
Deep understanding of containerization and distributed systems, with production experience in Kubernetes (required).
Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or similar).
Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server (administration, performance tuning, backup/restore, high availability).
Experience with Redis in production (caching, session storage, pub/sub).
Strong knowledge of networking, security, and system architecture.
Experience working in high-availability SaaS environments.
Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and incident management, including Grafana dashboards and alerting.
Automation-first mindset.
Experience collaborating with backend engineering teams.
Languages: fluent Spanish and professional English (both required).

We don’t expect you to master every tool listed above, but we do expect solid hands-on experience with at least one technology in each area: cloud provider (AWS / Azure), containers & orchestration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and databases & caching.

Nice-to-Have Superpowers

Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements.
Experience with cost optimization strategies in cloud environments.
Knowledge of GitOps workflows.
Experience in multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure.
Scripting skills (Bash, Python).
French — a huge plus (we can dream!).

Información adicional

Participar en la aventura AI First de Septeo y descubrir nuevas formas de trabajar gracias a la inteligencia artificial.
Crecer y desarrollarse gracias a un itinerario de formación personalizado y a oportunidades de movilidad interna.
Vivir una experiencia humana, intercambiar y compartir en eventos temáticos como encuentros afterwork, actividades deportivas, iniciativas de RSC, seminarios y mucho más.
Unirse a un equipo que cuida de los demás y se compromete con la igualdad de oportunidades, la diversidad y la inclusión.

jobs.title: Backend Developer - Turkish Speaking
jobs.description:
About Codeway

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale.

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two.

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us.

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Education), Sparked (Media), Cosmic Jam (Entertainment), and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space.

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.

Turns out you can do both.

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, Backend at Codeway, you will design, build, and operate the scalable backend services that power mobile apps and web experiences used by millions. You won't just write code; you will own features end-to-end - from initial system design and AI integration to deployment and production monitoring - with a strong focus on API quality, performance, and reliability.

Our environment is fast-paced, and we value engineers who can turn complex architectural challenges into simple, elegant, and maintainable solutions. The ideal candidate will be comfortable building backend services for mobile products and working with API-heavy consumer apps.

You will collaborate with mobile, product, AI, and DevOps teams to ship features end to end, bringing AI-powered capabilities into production where relevant.

What You’ll Be Doing

Design and implement scalable systems. Build high-performance backend architectures and microservices/RESTful APIs for mobile and web clients using Node.js and Python.
Own features end-to-end. Take full responsibility for the lifecycle of your services, from ideation and implementation through to deployment (GCP/Firebase) and continuous optimisation.
Integrate AI and media workflows. Deploy, monitor, and support LLMs and media workflows (STT/TTS, image/video/audio processing) in production, managing model serving, inference performance, and latency/cost tradeoffs.
Architect asynchronous workflows. Implement robust event-driven systems using queues and tasks to handle heavy media and AI workloads.
Simplify systems. Evaluate every component and process to remove unnecessary complexity and build minimalist, future-proof architectures.
Optimise performance. Proactively identify bottlenecks across distributed systems to improve latency, throughput, reliability, and costs.
Ensure backend quality. Establish robust error handling, security best practices, and end-to-end observability, and contribute to code quality through reviews, testing, and documentation.
Troubleshoot and stabilise. Debug issues and proactively improve system stability and observability in production environments.
Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner with Mobile, Frontend, Product, DevOps, and AI teams to design and ship impactful features.

What You’ll Bring

Experience. 3+ years of professional experience as a Backend Engineer, with a track record of building consumer-facing products at scale.
Technical excellence. Strong hands-on proficiency in both Node.js and Python, with a deep understanding of CS fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and system design.
System design. Experience designing and working with microservices architectures and RESTful APIs, with a solid grasp of databases, data modelling, performance optimisation, and security best practices.
Infrastructure knowledge. Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as GCP, AWS, or Azure (GCP and/or Firebase preferred), with strong production debugging and observability habits.
AI familiarity. Experience deploying and optimising AI models in production, including familiarity with external AI APIs and their performance considerations.
Scale. Ability to contribute effectively in high-scale environments handling large volumes of traffic and data, with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Communication. Proficiency in English and Turkish, with the ability to explain complex engineering decisions and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical teams.
Education. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Nice to have

Experience supporting mobile apps through backend APIs.
Experience with GCP tools such as Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, or App Engine.
Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.
Familiarity with SSE or WebSockets for real-time communication.
Experience with message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS.

What We Offer

The chance to work with a high-caliber, passionate international team building category-defining products
Full-time contract with competitive salary
Private health insurance, a generous meal card
Full visa & relocation support if you’re moving to Barcelona
Annual learning & development budget for courses, tools, or events that support your growth
Wellness perks, including sports budget and psychological consultations.
Free access to Codeway’s suite of apps across productivity, wellness, and education
A top-notch office in the heart of the city

jobs.description:
NTT DATA
es una consultora multinacional que ofrece soluciones tecnológicas, de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, siendo un referente en consultoría.

Digital Technology
es la unidad enfocada a acompañar a las grandes organizaciones iberoamericanas en su transformación digital, generando dividendos digitales a través de la tecnología y el diseño, con enfoque práctico y orientado al negocio. Para lograrlo, buscamos personas que compartan nuestra curiosidad permanente, pasión por la tecnología, excelencia constante y visión estratégica.

Digital Architecture
es la división que proporciona la estrategia tecnológica y las plataformas IT necesarias para impulsar la digitalización y transformación de nuestros clientes, ofreciendo soluciones cloud-native y siendo referentes en la construcción de arquitecturas robustas, seguras y que contemplen todas las necesidades.

En Digital Architecture estamos en búsqueda de profesionales con experiencia en arquitectura de integración
, capaces de diseñar soluciones que conecten aplicaciones, sistemas y servicios de forma segura, escalable y eficiente.

¿Qué esperamos encontrar?
Aunque no todo es imprescindible, nos gustaría que tuvieras:
Como mínimo 5 años de experiencia
en diseño, desarrollo y gestión de soluciones de integración entre sistemas, aplicaciones y plataformas.
Experiencia en definición de arquitecturas de integración
basadas en APIs, eventos, servicios, mensajería o modelos híbridos.
Conocimientos en especificaciones y estándares de integración
como OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, REST, SOAP, gRPC o equivalentes.
Experiencia con plataformas y herramientas de integración
como MuleSoft, Apigee, Kong, IBM API Connect, TIBCO, WebMethods, Kafka, RabbitMQ u otras tecnologías similares.
Conocimientos de seguridad en integración
, incluyendo OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, API Keys, certificados o mecanismos de autenticación y autorización entre sistemas.
Se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia en plataformas cloud
como AWS, Azure o Google Cloud, así como en arquitecturas híbridas, microservicios, contenedores o despliegues cloud-native.
También se valorará la familiaridad con frameworks de desarrollo
como Spring Boot, NestJS, Express.js o equivalentes.

Más que el conocimiento de una única plataforma, buscamos criterio para diseñar el modelo de integración más adecuado
en cada contexto: APIs, eventos, mensajería, servicios o arquitecturas híbridas.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?
Diseñar y definir arquitecturas de integración end-to-end alineadas con los objetivos de negocio, los sistemas existentes y la evolución tecnológica de cada cliente.
Seleccionar y aplicar patrones de integración basados en APIs, eventos, servicios, mensajería o modelos híbridos, según las necesidades del caso de uso.
Acompañar la implementación de integraciones entre aplicaciones, plataformas corporativas, canales digitales y servicios externos.
Garantizar la seguridad, escalabilidad, rendimiento, observabilidad y mantenibilidad de las soluciones implementadas.
Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo, negocio, infraestructura y arquitectura para asegurar decisiones técnicas coherentes y entregas de calidad.
Definir estándares, modelos de gobierno y criterios de reutilización para APIs, eventos y activos de integración.
Aportar criterio técnico en la elección y evolución de herramientas, plataformas y patrones de integración.
Documentar arquitecturas, APIs, flujos y activos reutilizables mediante herramientas de diseño, gobierno y documentación técnica.

📍 Aunque nuestra búsqueda está centrada principalmente en Valladolid, también tenemos equipos en Barcelona, Madrid, Sevilla, Valencia y Zaragoza. Por lo que si vives en estas u otras ciudades también nos interesa tu perfil y estaremos encantados de conocerte.

🌊 Programas solidarios y actividades sociales para impulsar un impacto positivo a través de nuestro portal de voluntarios The Blue Wave .

🌏 Innovación diversa y cultura inclusiva. En NTT DATA creemos que cada persona es única y apostamos por una cultura que valora la diversidad y fomenta un entorno donde todos podamos explorar y potenciar nuestra singularidad.

jobs.description:
Senior ServiceNow Developer/ Consultant

The opportunity

ServiceNow is a global tool used widely to manage business processes of Enterprise clients and our ServiceNow team is part of the global structure of EY as a Global Elite partner of ServiceNow. Involving different roles and stakeholders we provide our customers with the best consultancy and solutions.

As member of our team, based in the EY GDS Spain office in Málaga,
you would be a part of project teams involved in implementation, configuration and maintenance of NowPlatform allowing you to develop your technical and business skills in global environment. As Global Elite ServiceNow partner EY works with all types of modules of the platform, heavily using their features and developing custom solutions not yet built by others.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Senior ServiceNow Developer, you will be tasked with directing the development and implementation of intricate business processes. This also involves the analysis of business requirements at all stages of development. You may have the opportunity to lead a team of consultants during projects or design the architecture of ServiceNow solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To excel in this role, you must possess a comprehensive understanding of the platform and exhibit confidence when working through implementation, customization or maintenance projects. This may be demonstrated through:

Outstanding knowledge of NowPlatform architecture with at least 3 years of professional experience
Experience in product customizations, integrations, implementation or maintenance
Experience in project activities as a Developer

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 3 years of ServiceNow implementation experience
Advanced ServiceNow CAD or CIS certification
Demonstrated experience with at least two programming languages (JavaScript, C#, Java or others)
Proven experience and advanced understanding of ITSM and HRSD
Showcased knowledge of Best Practices in Software Development
Thorough understanding of ITIL and Agile methodologies
Excellent communication skills in English (B2 – C1)

Ideally, you’ll also have

Spanish, German, French or other European languages would be an advantage but not mandatory
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technical field or economic field

What We Look For

We are looking to hire a Senior ServiceNow Developer/ Consultant, who is passionate about creating innovative and bespoke solutions for our clients. We value individuals who wish to expand their product knowledge, work with global stakeholders across different workflows of product, and potentially progress to architect, tech lead, dev lead, or project management roles. If you are keen on initiating discussions and overseeing projects right up to post go-live activities - we are looking for you.

What We Offer

In EY GDS Spain, we’re committed to fostering a vibrant environment where every team member can thrive. We provide a space for continuous learning and the flexibility to define your own success, empowering you to make a meaningful impact in your own way. Our diverse and inclusive culture values who you are and encourages you to help others find their voice.

Additionally, here’s what makes us stand out:

Empowering Career Development: Unlock your potential with tailored training and development programs designed to elevate your skills and propel your career forward. We invest in your growth because your success is our success.
Flexible Work-Life Integration: Enjoy the freedom of our hybrid work model, allowing you to blend professional responsibilities with personal passions. We understand that life is more than just work, and we support you in achieving that balance.
Comprehensive Well-Being Programs: Prioritize your health with our extensive wellness initiatives, including psychological support sessions and health resources. At EY GDS Spain, your well-being is at the heart of what we do.
Meaningful Volunteering Opportunities: Make a difference in your community through our engaging volunteering programs. Join us in giving back and creating a positive impact while building connections with like-minded colleagues.
Recognized Performance and Rewards: Celebrate your achievements with our recognition programs that honor both individual and team successes. We believe in acknowledging hard work and dedication, ensuring you feel valued every step of the way.

Join us at EY GDS Spain, where your journey is supported, your contributions are celebrated, and your future is bright.

To learn more about what we offer, visit our

Careers in Global Delivery Services | EY - Global
page.

About EY GDS

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is the hub of innovation, a technology powerhouse, a global talent center and a driver of operational excellence within EY, propelling EY’s purpose of building a better working world. With a robust network spread across 8 countries and 21 cities, EY GDS’ dynamic network of highly talented professionals leverage data, AI, and leading-edge technology to enhance EY's wide array of services in Assurance, Consulting, Tax and EY-Parthenon.

By seamlessly integrating with EY member firms across the globe, EY GDS contributes significantly to EY's purposeful and sustainable growth, delivering insights and solutions that foster trust in capital markets and create value for EY clients, society, and the planet.

EY GDS is all in to shape the future with confidence, addressing today's challenges, and anticipating tomorrow's needs. EY GDS is not just reimagining the future of work—it's actively building it, ensuring agility, efficiency, and resilience in an ever-evolving world.

If you are interested in being part of our team, we kindly invite you to submit your CV in English to apply for this position.

Job Description

You will join the managed services team of a global technology company in Sofia, which runs the database platforms of 5–6 client organisations end to end. As the senior database engineer, you are theL3 expert for Microsoft SQL Server, and you also work hands-on on an Oracle estate of more than 50 instances (about 25 TB, mostly 19c, including RAC).

The team is cross-skilled: MS SQL Server is the main technology, and you are expected to understand how things work in Oracle and to operate it confidently.

Your Responsibilities

Act as the L3 expert for MS SQL Server across 5–6 client environments.
Administer and troubleshoot Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, replication and standalone instances.
Analyse and tune performance: queries, indexes, waits, blocking and resource use.
Run backup and recovery with native and third-party tools; test restores regularly.
Apply cumulative updates, upgrades and security hardening; manage logins and permissions.
Operate Oracle 19c SE/EE databases on Linux and Windows, including RAC, Grid Infrastructure and RMAN backups with a third-party backup tool.
Handle incidents, problems, changes and service requests under ITIL, in and out of business hours; record all work in ServiceNow.
Carry out proactive work: health checks, capacity reviews, backup verification and documentation.
Automate recurring tasks with T-SQL, PowerShell (e.g. dbatools) or Ansible.
Manage vendor cases with Microsoft and Oracle on behalf of the client’s customers.

Our Requirements

6+ years as an MS SQL Server DBA in production, with several years at expert (L3) level.
Hands-on experience with Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances and

replication.

Strong performance tuning, backup and recovery skills.
2+ years hands-on Oracle administration, including 19c, RAC and RMAN.
Working-level Windows Server and Linux administration.
T-SQL and PowerShell scripting.
Working in ITIL processes with ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM tool.
Fluent English, written and spoken (C1).
Resident in Bulgaria and able to work from Bulgaria only.
Willing to take part in the standby rotation.

Standby and out-of-hours

You join the client team’s standby rotation for your technology: one to two slots per week, 12 hours on weekdays and 24 hours at weekends, with no more than 100 standby hours per month.
Standby is remote. Alerts arrive by phone from the first-line team, and you connect within the response target (15 minutes for critical incidents).
Planned change and maintenance work outside business hours is scheduled in advance, typically 5–15 hours per month.
Standby hours and out-of-hours work are compensated separately from the day rate.

Internal Mobility Program – enjoy many opportunities for career growth, job rotations, diversity of projects & technologies
Referral Program – enjoy cooperation with your colleagues and get a bonus!

Education – benefit from our know-how, learning courses and certificates and IT events – be part of the community of leaders of the industry and take part as a speaker or a visitor

Language courses

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer — Taxx.lu
jobs.description:
Role overview

Want to join the team that revolutionised tax filing in Luxembourg?
Are you looking for a new challenge in a small, fast-moving team, where your work has a real and direct impact on the lives of Luxembourg taxpayers?
Since 2018, taxx.lu has been the leader in online tax filing in Luxembourg. Our platform allows everyone to file their Luxembourg tax return as simply, quickly and reliably as possible.
To continue growing our team, we are now looking for a full-stack developer
to build the application behind it. You will help us build reliable, secure and well-structured features that support the filing experience, our support team and our AI-enabled capabilities.
This is a hands-on role, combining feature development, code review and close collaboration with Product and our tax specialists.

Your responsibilities

Build and maintain features ·        Design, develop and maintain features across the application, from data model to interface.
·        Translate Luxembourg tax rules and annual regulatory changes into working product, together with Product and our tax specialists.
·        Turn requirements into clear specifications with explicit scope and acceptance criteria.
·        Contribute to the evolution of the platform's architecture.

Write and review code to the same standard ·        Review pull requests, whether written by a colleague or generated by an agent.
·        Investigate and fix defects reported in production: reproduce, isolate and correct the cause.
·        Improve the reliability, performance and security of existing code.
·        Refactor where complexity accumulates and keep the application maintainable as it grows.

Develop with AI AI is becoming an increasingly important part of our technology landscape.
You will contribute to making agent-assisted development reliable and to defining the conventions and guardrails that agents work from, while ensuring appropriate quality, security and human oversight. We expect the same engineering principles whether code is written by a person or generated by an agent: version control, testing, code reviews, monitoring, automated deployments, documentation and maintainable solutions.

What we are looking for We are more interested in engineering fundamentals than in experience with one particular framework.

Essential skills ·        Demonstrable experience building and shipping web applications, whether professionally, through open-source work or through substantial personal projects.
·        Solid understanding of web application architecture and of common patterns such as MVC.
·        Experience with relational data modelling, migrations and SQL.
·        Good command of web fundamentals: HTTP and REST, authentication and authorisation, sessions, background jobs, caching.
·        Experience with automated testing, and an understanding of what to test at which level.
·        Ability to read and debug code written by others, including in production.
·        Ability to plan a feature: decompose it, define acceptance criteria and anticipate edge cases.
·        Practical experience working with AI coding agents.
·        Comfortable with Git and modern engineering practices.
·        Ability to work autonomously and collaborate with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
·        Professional English.

Nice to have ·        Ruby and Ruby on Rails.
·        PostgreSQL.
·        Tailwind CSS.
·        Heroku and AWS.
·        GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines.
·        Devise or another authentication framework.
·        Experience introducing coding agents into a team's workflow.
·        Knowledge of Luxembourg personal taxation.
·        French, German or Luxembourgish.
Experience with Rails is an advantage rather than a requirement. We allow for a proper learning period on our stack and on Luxembourg tax matters, and we expect you to be contributing to production code within your first weeks.

The profile we value We are looking for someone who:
·        Cares about correctness and about how the product is experienced by the user.
·        Plans before implementing, and is comfortable defining what is in and out of scope.
·        Takes ownership of what they build, including in production.
·        Values simple, maintainable architectures.
·        Is curious about developments in AI-assisted engineering and pragmatic about their limits.
·        Enjoys working in a lean, collaborative environment with short decision paths.

What we offer With more than 25 years on the Luxembourg market, atHome Group is a leading operator of digital platforms that support people through major life decisions — property, mobility, financing and tax — through the atHome, Luxauto, atHome Finance and taxx brands.
Driven by innovation, data and people-centred digitalisation, our mission is to make life decisions simpler, more efficient and less stressful.

The role offers the opportunity to: ·        Work on a product with a direct impact on taxpayers in Luxembourg, with a clear annual rhythm around the filing season.
·        Take technical ownership within a lean team with short decision paths.
·        Help shape how AI is adopted in our development lifecycle.
·        Build expertise in Luxembourg personal taxation.
·        Work in a flexible environment in Luxembourg, on a permanent full-time contract.

Recruitment process ·        Applications open until October 31st.
·        Introductory interview with HR.
·        Technical deep dive: review of a real issue and pull request from our codebase.
·        Final interview with leadership.

new_jobs.title: Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT Utrecht & Haarlem - Jobbird.com
new_jobs.description:
Werk aan innovatieve IT-oplossingen die Nederland in beweging houden. Maak impact, groei mee en bouw aan de digitale toekomst van NS.

Jij zorgt voor de mobiliteit van Nederland
Veel ontwikkel-mogelijkheden
Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden

Daarom wil je als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT bij NS werken

Je werkt aan technologie die direct bijdraagt aan betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig treinvervoer.
Je ontwikkelt en verbetert een bedrijfskritisch MES-platform op het snijvlak van IT, OT, techniek en productie.
Je krijgt veel ruimte om slimme oplossingen te ontwerpen voor de modernisering van onze treinen in Haarlem, dicht op de operatie.

Dit ga je doen als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT

Als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT bij NS werk je aan het Manufacturing Execution System (MES) binnen NS Treinmodernisering in Haarlem. Dit bedrijfskritische platform, gebaseerd op AspenTech, ondersteunt de productie- en onderhoudsprocessen waarmee treinen worden gemoderniseerd. Daarmee heeft jouw werk direct impact op de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van onze treinen.

Deze functie is anders dan een klassieke fullstack ontwikkelaarsrol. Je werkt niet alleen aan software, maar ook aan configuratie, integraties, procesontwerp en technische continuïteit binnen een operationele productieomgeving. Je schakelt met operators, productieondersteuning, functioneel beheerders, ontwikkelaars en andere collega’s om gebruikersvragen te vertalen naar robuuste technische oplossingen.

Je ontwikkelt nieuwe functionaliteiten, verbetert bestaande oplossingen en helpt verstoringen structureel op te lossen. Daarbij werk je met onder andere SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en MES-processen. Je denkt mee over de technische roadmap, migraties, beveiliging en de toekomst van het MES-landschap. Zo bouw je mee aan een platform dat belangrijk is voor de modernisering van treinen én voor de dagelijkse operatie in de fabriek.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

Je ontwikkelt, configureert en onderhoudt oplossingen binnen het AspenTech MES-platform.
Je vertaalt productie- en onderhoudsprocessen naar robuuste, schaalbare en praktisch toepasbare technische ontwerpen.
Je werkt aan nieuwe functionaliteiten, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en optimalisaties binnen het MES-landschap.
Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken en lost technische verstoringen structureel op, soms direct in contact met de fabriek.
Je neemt een leidende rol in technische ontwerpkeuzes en bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en veiligheid van oplossingen.
Je werkt nauw samen met functioneel beheerders, een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers zoals operators en productieondersteuning.
Je denkt mee over technische migraties, contracten, beveiliging en toekomstige ontwikkelingen op de roadmap van het MES-platform.
Je ondersteunt bij releases, migraties en technische verbetertrajecten.
Je deelt kennis binnen het team en helpt collega’s technisch verder, zodat de afhankelijkheid van enkele kennishouders kleiner wordt.

Hier ga je werken

Je komt terecht in het MES-team binnen NS Treinmodernisering in Haarlem. Hier worden treinen vernieuwd, verbeterd en toekomstbestendig gemaakt. Binnen die omgeving speelt digitalisering een steeds grotere rol. Het MES-platform ondersteunt collega’s op de werkvloer bij productie- en onderhoudsprocessen en vormt daarmee een belangrijke schakel tussen IT, OT en de dagelijkse operatie.

Het team bestaat uit een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars, een technisch applicatiebeheerder en een functioneel beheerder. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat het MES-platform stabiel blijft draaien én meegroeit met de behoefte van de fabriek. Je werkt in een omgeving waar techniek, softwareontwikkeling en productie samenkomen. Dat vraagt om nauwkeurigheid, eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de rust om ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag werk je aan een strategische verbetering van het platform, de andere dag help je een verstoring oplossen die direct impact heeft op de productie. Juist die combinatie van IT, techniek en operatie maakt deze functie interessant voor een ontwikkelaar die graag dicht bij de praktijk werkt.

Dit zijn de functie-eisen

Je bent een ervaren IT-professional of softwareontwikkelaar die technische diepgang combineert met een praktische aanpak. Je vindt het interessant om complexe systemen te doorgronden en krijgt energie van het slimmer maken van productieprocessen. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, denkt goed na over je aanpak en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen.

Verder herken je jezelf in het volgende:

Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van technische informatica, software engineering, industriële automatisering of vergelijkbaar.
Je hebt ruime ervaring als software engineer, systems engineer, IT engineer of ontwikkelaar binnen complexe en bedrijfskritische IT-landschappen.
Je hebt ervaring met of aantoonbare affiniteit met MES-systemen, productieomgevingen en industriële automatisering.
Ervaring met AspenTech MES, ASM of vergelijkbare MES-platformen is een sterke pré.
Je hebt goede kennis van SQL, databases en systeemintegraties.
Je hebt ervaring met JavaScript, TypeScript en bij voorkeur enige kennis van .NET.
Je hebt ervaring met API’s, koppelingen, data-integraties en technische architecturen.
Je kunt zelfstandig verstoringen analyseren, prioriteiten bepalen en tot een structurele oplossing komen.
Je communiceert duidelijk en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen, van ontwikkelaars tot gebruikers op de werkvloer.
Je bent stressbestendig, verandergericht en zelfbewust: je blijft rustig bij onverwachte situaties en durft keuzes te maken met oog voor kwaliteit en samenwerking.

Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de dynamische wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. En als één van de mooiste werkgevers van Nederland hebben we nog meer te bieden. Voor deze functie onder meer:

Een salaris tussen € 3.743,- en € 6.491,- bruto per maand op basis van schaal 60 en een 36-urige werkweek. Je inschaling is afhankelijk van je werkervaring.
De mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en flexibele werktijden, in overleg.
Een 36-urige werkweek.
3% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantietoeslag en een uitstekende pensioenregeling.

Gratis treinreizen in de 2e klas. Reizen in de 1e klas kan tegen een kleine eigen bijdrage.

144 uur wettelijk verlof op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, plus extra verlof afhankelijk van je leeftijd. Dit is minimaal een week.
De mogelijkheid om 3 christelijke feestdagen om te ruilen voor 3 niet-christelijke feestdagen.
Korting op Europese treinreizen zodra je 1 jaar bij NS werkt.
Een keuzeplan met onder andere een fietsenplan, extra pensioenopbouw of extra vakantiedagen.

Wil je meer weten? Bekijk dan onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en cao.

Solliciteren naar deze baan

new_jobs.description:
Afstudeerstage / Meewerkstage Software Testen, een echte smaakmaker

Wil jij tijdens je stage echt verschil maken? Bij de gemeente Ede krijg je als stagiair(e) de kans om onze testaanpak voor software te verbeteren én direct in de praktijk te brengen. Zo draag je bij aan betere dienstverlening voor inwoners en ondernemers.

Ben jij nieuwsgierig en analytisch? Vind je het leuk om mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen? Werk je graag zelfstandig, maar zoek je ook actief de samenwerking op? Dan is dit misschien een interessante stage voor jou.

Tijdens je afstudeerperiode of stage werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van een toekomstbestendige en praktisch bruikbare testaanpak. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk en krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Je gaat bijvoorbeeld:

de huidige testwerkwijze in kaart brengen: hoe testen we nu, wat gaat goed en wat kan beter?
best practices onderzoeken, onder andere bij andere gemeenten en in de IT-branche;
een uniforme testaanpak ontwerpen die past bij de gemeente Ede;
meedenken over en meewerken aan de inrichting van Testersuite;
testscenario’s en testcases opstellen en uitvoeren voor echte wijzigingen en releases;
gebruikers begeleiden tijdens een pilot met de nieuwe aanpak en feedback ophalen;
de pilot evalueren en verbeterpunten formuleren;
een concreet advies schrijven voor verdere implementatie.

Aan het einde van je stage heb je:

een onderzoeksrapport dat aansluit bij de eisen van jouw opleiding (HBO/WO);
een werkbare testaanpak en ingerichte testomgeving als basis voor de organisatie;
een duidelijk implementatieadvies waarmee de gemeente verder kan.

Voor welk type stage is dit geschikt?

De opdracht is geschikt als:

afstudeeropdracht (scriptie) voor 3e- of 4e-jaars studenten;
meewerkstage, waarbij je onderzoek combineert met dagelijks meewerken.

We stemmen de onderzoeksopzet en leerdoelen samen met jou en je opleiding af.

Waarom is deze stage interessant voor jou?

Maatschappelijke impact: jouw werk zorgt ervoor dat systemen waar inwoners en collega’s dagelijks mee werken, betrouwbaarder worden.
Moderne tools: je gaat werken met een testmanagementtool (Testersuite) en ziet hoe testen in een complexe organisatie werkt.
Professionele begeleiding: je krijgt inhoudelijke begeleiding van ervaren functioneel beheerders en projectmedewerkers, afgestemd op de eisen van jouw opleiding.
Ruimte voor eigen initiatief: je krijgt de mogelijkheid om eigen ideeën uit te werken en daadwerkelijk bij te dragen aan de professionalisering van onze organisatie.

Wie zijn wij

Gemeente Ede, smaakmakers van de Veluwe

Ede is veelzijdig: wonen, werken, recreëren kent in Ede vele smaken. Van het levendig centrum in de stad Ede tot het gevarieerde buitengebied en de natuur van de Veluwe. Een groot gebied met dorpen en stad. We kijken hoe we inwoners verder helpen door goed te luisteren. En geven duidelijk aan wat we te bieden hebben. Wist je dat we bij onze gemeente de nadruk op voedsel en gezondheid leggen? Tegelijkertijd focussen we met zo’n 1200 collega’s op andere belangrijke zaken. Denk aan het zorgen voor voldoende woningen en het werken aan leefbaarheid en duurzaamheid. Voor iedereen, want iedereen is welkom. Onze samenleving en omgeving is continu in ontwikkeling, wij bewegen mee en kijken vooruit. Dat maakt ons wendbaar en weerbaar.

De gemeente Ede zet in op diversiteit. Niet alleen op het gebied van geslacht, afkomst, geaardheid of leeftijd, ook op het gebied van talenten, kennis en vaardigheden. We geloven dat deze diversiteit ons in staat stelt onze maatschappelijke opgaven en uitdagingen aan te gaan. We werken daarom aan een cultuur waarin iedereen zich betrokken voelt.

Benieuwd wat Ede allemaal te bieden heeft? Bekijk de video en onze website! https://www.werkenbijede.nl/werken-bij-ede (https://www.werkenbijede.nl/werken-bij-ede)

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Backend
new_jobs.description:
About Us:
At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

The ITS Development team in the IT Services department, part of the Central Tech business unit, provides technical expertise to support internal technology platforms and services across the organisation. We are responsible for developing, maintaining, and evolving solutions that enable efficient IT operations, streamline business processes, and improve the employee experience. Our goal is to empower teams with reliable, scalable, and well-integrated technology that supports Booking.com’s business and technology communities.

Role Overview

Within the IT Services Development team, a software engineer takes part in designing, implementing and maintaining internal tools, systems, services and integrations which enable the workforce at Booking.com and other Booking Holdings brands to be mobile and productive.

The team’s services ownership scope includes, but is not limited to, the following aspects:

User provisioning mechanisms, interconnecting company’s Identity and Authorization Management system to 3rd party applications
Employee data synchronization and internal exposure services
Employee Benefits Program management service
Corporate offices meeting rooms management service
Employee communications management systems

Programming languages and key technologies used within the team are:

Hosting platforms: Booking Kubernetes Services (private cloud) / AWS / Mulesoft
Programming languages: Java, TypeScript
Other technologies used: Mulesoft, MySQL, Kafka, React

The team (along with the all the Tech & Product teams) uses agile methodology.

Key Job Responsibilities And Duties

Designing and building software applications, automations and integration by using relevant development languages and technologies, and applying knowledge of systems, services and tools appropriate for the business area
Build template solutions on complex integration cases and liaise with our business stakeholders and traduce their business needs into Integration solutions.
Maintaining and supporting existing integration interfaces.
Createing technical design and actual implementation of solutions.
Owning a service end to end by actively monitoring application/integration health and performance, setting and monitoring relevant metrics and act accordingly when violated
Identify and resolve live production issues by mitigating the customer impact within SLA
Evaluating possible architecture solutions by taking into account cost, business requirements, technology requirements and emerging technologies
Identifying opportunities for process, system and structural improvements (i.e performance gains) by examining and evaluating current process flows, methods and standards
Drive and implement solutions for automations or new functionalities in the reliability tools
Delivering clear, well-structured, and meaningful information to a target audience by using suitable communication mediums and language tailored to the audience

Role Qualifications And Requirements

Min 5+ years of experience in the IT industry
Minimum of 3 years software development experience.
Strong working knowledge and experience with Java / SpringBoot
Good understanding of concepts such as Mulesoft, EDA, MOA, SOA, SOAP, REST APIs, RESTful, RPC/RFC, event streams such as Kafka and different integration patterns.
Integration platform experience with Mule 4.x, CloudHub 1.0, (Ideally some experience on CloudHub 2.0)
Exposure to a variety of enterprise architectures from a large monolithic architecture to hybrid landscapes consisting of distributed systems and microservices and event-driven architectures.
Experience of API led design using RAML/OAS and experience of supporting APIs through the full API lifecycle and system observability is a plus (Graphite, Grafana etc.)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication; written and spoken and experience working with non-technical stakeholders

Benefits & Perks: Global Impact, Personal Relevance

Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parental (22-weeks paid leave), grandparent, bereavement, and care leave.
Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, working from home furniture and ergonomic support, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country).
A beautiful sustainable HQ Campus in Amsterdam, that offers on-site meals, coffee, and snacks, multi-faith and breastfeeding rooms at the office.
Commuting allowance and bike reimbursement scheme.
Discounts & Wallet credits to spend on our products, upgrade to Booking.com Genius Level 3, and friends & family Booking.com discount vouchers.
Free access to online learning platforms, development and mentorship programs.
Global Employee Assistance Program, free Headspace membership.

Inclusion at Booking.com:

Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”

We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

This role does not come with relocation assistance, therefore candidates must be currently based in the Netherlands in order to be considered.

Java

AWS

new_jobs.title: Data & AI Platform Architect | Kaag of Amsterdam
new_jobs.description:
Breng data, AI en innovatie samen in een unieke omgeving. Als Data & AI Platform Architect bouw je aan slimme oplossingen die de digitale toekomst van Feadship vormgeven en direct bijdragen aan de bouw van 's werelds mooiste superjachten.

Jouw aandeel in de bouw van een Feadship

Bij Royal van Lent Shipyards op de Kaag bouwen we unieke superjachten van 70 tot 100 meter. Van begin tot eind exact zoals de klant wenst. Deze jachten worden gekenmerkt door innovatie, schoonheid en betrouwbaarheid.
Daar lever jij een belangrijke bijdrage aan. Een Feadship bouwen vraagt expertise en we waarderen jouw vakmanschap op het gebied van IT, finance, control, logistiek, HR of facility. Neem jij de ruimte om op jouw manier te doen waar je goed in bent?

Dit ga je doen als Data & AI Platform Architect

Als Data & AI Platform Architect ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen business en technologie. Je vertaalt informatiebehoeften naar slimme data- en AI-oplossingen en zorgt ervoor dat deze veilig, schaalbaar en toekomstbestendig worden ingericht.
Je ontwikkelt en implementeert data- en AI-oplossingen die bijdragen aan datagedreven besluitvorming.
Je vertaalt wensen vanuit de business naar concrete functionaliteiten en begeleidt de realisatie hiervan.
Je optimaliseert ons dataplatform en bouwt mee aan een schaalbare data-architectuur.
Je initieert en realiseert AI-projecten, van use case tot succesvolle ingebruikname.
Je integreert AI-functionaliteiten in bestaande processen en applicaties.
Je adviseert stakeholders over de mogelijkheden van data en AI en stimuleert adoptie binnen de organisatie.

Dit breng je mee

Een hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting Informatica, Data Science, Business Intelligence of vergelijkbaar.
Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen data-, BI- en/of AI-omgevingen.
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
Ervaring met Power BI, datamodellering, ETL-processen, datalakes en datawarehouses.

Jouw vaardigheden:

Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch vermogen en weet complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar praktische oplossingen.
Je bent creatief, innovatief en continu op zoek naar verbeteringen en nieuwe toepassingen van AI.
Je combineert technische diepgang met sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en weet stakeholders mee te nemen in veranderingen.

Onze Voorkeur Gaat Uit Naar Kandidaten Met

Ervaring met AI-technologieën, machine learning en generatieve AI-oplossingen.
Kennis van data governance, datakwaliteit en Master Data Management (MDM).
Ervaring met het ontwerpen van schaalbare dataarchitecturen en het realiseren van complexe datatransformaties.

Ons aanbod

Naast een uitdagende functie binnen een innovatieve omgeving waar technologie en vakmanschap samenkomen, bieden wij volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en direct impact te maken op de digitale transformatie van Royal van Lent. Je werkt samen met gedreven collega's aan oplossingen die bijdragen aan de bouw van de mooiste superjachten ter wereld.
Bij Royal Van Lent Shipyard Willen We Dat Jij Niet Alleen Floreert In Je Carrière, Maar Ook Geniet Van Een Gezonde Balans Tussen Werk En Privé. Daarom Hebben We Een Aantrekkelijk En Compleet Aanbod Samengesteld
Salaris: Een salaris van € 5500 en maximaal € 8500.
Stabiele toekomst: Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
Riante vrije dagen: Bij fulltime dienstverband ontvang je maar liefst 40 vrije dagen per jaar (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen).
Aantrekkelijke extra's: Naast 8% vakantiegeld ontvang je een gegarandeerde aanvulling van 2,75% tot 2027.
Deel in ons succes: Een jaarlijkse winstuitkering (conditioneel).
Goed geregeld voor later: Een solide pensioenregeling via PME en een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering voor aanvullende pakketten.
Reiskostenvergoeding: € 0,23 per kilometer, op basis van je woon-werkafstand.
Flexibiliteit: Werk met flexibele werktijden, afgestemd in overleg met je leidinggevende.
Plezier met collega’s: Een actieve personeelsvereniging die zorgt voor gezellige activiteiten zoals een sloepentocht, zomer-BBQ, sinterklaasfeest of pubquiz.
Persoonlijke groei: Toegang tot volop opleidingsmogelijkheden via de Feadship Academie, zodat je kunt blijven groeien.
Hybride werken: Werk deels vanuit huis en deels op een van onze prachtige locaties.

Sluit je aan bij ons team en ervaar de unieke sfeer van werken aan superjachten bij Royal Van Lent Shipyard!

new_jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OLX

We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems
that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe
, smart
, and environmentally responsible
.

We do this with courage
to innovate, commitment
to outcomes, collaboration
across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led
approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win
– and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.

Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.

Join OLX And See How Far You Can Go.

Join Our Team as an AI-native Staff Backend Engineer!

Join one of our cross-functional teams in Motors, Real Estate, OLX Classifieds, or Platforms, working remotely from Poland.

Are you someone who is craving scalable problems and dealing with optimizations?

You'll work with a creative, critical, and well-organized team from the comfort of your house, but as close as we have ever been!

You will play a key role in enabling our organisation to scale efficiently.

Who We Are Looking For

You can use agentic workflows (Claude Code, Cursor Agent, or equivalent) as your default, not as a novelty.
You practice context engineering, not just prompt engineering; you design the full information architecture an AI agent needs to succeed: repo structure, CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md configs, relevant code context, memory, and tool access.
You understand model routing trade-offs (e.g., when to use Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus) and multi-agent orchestration.
Strong ownership instinct: AI output is a first draft, not a deliverable; you validate, refactor, and take full accountability.
You have strong Coding and Computer Science Fundamentals. Roughly ⅔ of your time will be hands-on technical work: designing solutions, steering and reviewing AI-generated code, developing new ideas, and reviewing others' contributions. The rest goes to cross-team influence, mentoring, and strategic alignment.
Strong background experience in Golang, Java/Kotlin (preferred technologies), and able to work with PHP. Flexible and capable of adjusting to changing project requirements, roles, and backend technologies as needed.
Scalable Systems Expertise. Experience with large-scale web applications, an economic-thinking mindset, and being able to design well-bounded future-proof domain systems, aligned with the business objectives.
Deep expertise in scalable distributed systems, CI/CD, RESTful and GraphQL APIs, AWS, and relational + NoSQL databases.
Big-picture thinker: aligns technical decisions with business strategy, influences without authority.
Clear communicator in English across engineering, product, and leadership audiences.
Self-starter who identifies what needs doing and takes initiative without waiting to be asked.
Skilled Technical Leader and Mentor: Guide and support engineers by setting a strong example. As a Staff Engineer, you are a role model, leading by example and through your expertise.

What You Will Be Doing

Architect context pipelines for AI agents: curate what enters the context window (repo boundaries, domain knowledge, test outputs, CI feedback) so agents produce reliable, mergeable code, not just plausible code.
Prepare task specifications that are agent-actionable (clear acceptance criteria, referenced modules, explicit constraints)
Design and maintain agent-ready systems: well-bounded repos, comprehensive test suites as guardrails, CI/CD pipelines with structured output agents can parse and act on.
Serve as an AI Champion: join and strengthen our growing AI Champion community, contribute to workshops, curate effective agentic workflows, and mentor engineers on AI-assisted practices. Contribute to org-level AI tooling evaluations and OLX AI practices repositories.
Drive active migration from a legacy monolith to microservices, owning decisions on bounded domain decomposition. Working on making agentic workflows effective across a codebase whose boundaries are actively being redefined.
Set the bar for GraphQL API design, RESTful contracts, database schema, and CI/CD quality across the tribe.
Work with product and engineering leadership to identify high-value problems, propose initiatives, and drive impactful technical direction without direct authority
Guide senior engineers in managing and reducing technical debt with AI as an accelerator, not a shortcut.

Our Benefits

Monthly salary and an annual bonus (20%)
Training and conference budget, and free access to Udemy courses
A benefits package with 500 points on the Mybenefit platform per month, private medical care provided by Luxmed, Ask Henry services, and much more
IP rights’ costs - 80%
100% remote work (as well as the possibility of working from our offices in Poznan and Warsaw)

If you'd like to learn more about us take a look around our careers page and the OLX Group website. Follow us on Linkedin and check out our OLX Group Engineering Blog and Twitter Tech .

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position.
